tools.name: search_restaurants
tools.description: Find independent UK restaurants that use TableSpark, by name, dish or cuisine words, town or postcode. Use this first to get a restaurant_id. Can filter to places open now, or that take table bookings or online orders.

tools.name: get_restaurant
tools.description: Address, phone, opening hours (with open-now and special dates), cuisine, and whether the restaurant takes table bookings, online orders and gift vouchers, with links to its website.

tools.name: get_menu
tools.description: The restaurant's published menu: sections, dishes, prices, dietary labels and allergens exactly as the restaurant lists them. Optional text or dietary filter. Returns item_id values for get_order_link.

tools.name: check_table_availability
tools.description: Live table times for a date and party size, from the restaurant's own booking system. Each time comes with a link to book it on the restaurant's website. Does not make a booking.

tools.name: get_booking_link
tools.description: Link to the restaurant's booking form on its own website, carrying the chosen date, party size and time. The guest completes and confirms the booking there.

tools.name: get_order_link
tools.description: Link to order from the restaurant's own website. Pass item_id values from get_menu to open it with those dishes already in the basket; the guest reviews, chooses collection or delivery and pays there.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: Upcoming events the restaurant lists on its website (tastings, live music, set evenings), with links.

tools.name: get_gift_voucher_link
tools.description: Link to buy the restaurant's gift vouchers on its own website.
